items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: Minnie Pearl. And she was an established organ player in Syracuse. So she came in, and plus they used an organ.

ctx.x: Minnie Pearl. And she was an established organ player in Syracuse. So she came in, and plus they used an organ. They couldn’t do a piano. But I will say one thing about working in that church. I didn’t go to the music school, I didn’t have the experience of playing in orchestras and all that stuff. But on Sunday morning at 11:00 when you have about a hundred people in the congregation and you’re playing the piano and they’re singing hymns, you can not screw up, and your sense of time and coordination really is at…
I know that accompanying can be a high pressure situation.
